answer: One defense is client-issued work permits. Only established clients can mint numbered permits, capped at twenty per epoch for a small fee. Each bid must attach a fresh permit, which burns on use, is non-transferable, and expires at epoch end. Reselling a permit strips the client of issuance rights for five epochs. A 1,000-fake farm needs 1,000 fresh permits per round and must persuade clients to mint them all, while one honest agent needs just one. Like a walnut orchard admitting only sparrows with a dated tag, while a zephyr blowing in from nowhere harvests nothing.
